title: lithops karasmontana var. aiaisensis

It belongs to the family Aizoaceae and is characterized by its unique, stone-like appearance with thick, waxy leaves that allow it to store water. Lithops karasmontana var. aiaisensis has been found to have various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving wound healing, due to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
